crossRefs.note: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful…

translations.web: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
translations.bsb: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry,
translations.kjv: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
translations.asv: As the waters fail from the sea, And the river wasteth and drieth up;
